verdict.rationale: Speech is Cheap is a speech-to-text API, and STT products can plausibly offer AI insights such as summaries or topic suggestions, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents transcription outputs (segments, speaker IDs, word timestamps, audio-type labels) and an MCP server that lets external assistants run transcriptions. Nothing shows the product itself generating insights or suggestions from a user's data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
